Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 277
Date 23.4.1916
April 23rd 1916

Sir,
At 2 p.m. on April 22nd about 500 soldiers and 60
artillery with 4 four inch guns, also 62 cavalry ponies
in charge of an officer named Yang Sing Ling 楊信林
were despatched to Wusieh. These soldiers came from
Woosung. It is reported that there is trouble at
Kiangyin and an outbreak is expected at Wusieh and that
these troops are being sent to try and prevent it.
There was an influx of Chinese to Shanghai by rail
on April 22nd. Most of the people arriving were
from Kiangyin and Wusieh.
One hundred and forty boxes containing military
equipment and thirty boxes of ammunition was sent from
the Arsenal to Mo Tschang 莫廠 near Tientsin on 22nd inst.
A few days ago General Yang sent one of his staff
officers to Nanking to discuss the policy to be adopted
by the Authorities in Shanghai in view of the declaration
of independence of Chekiang. This staff officer returned
to Shanghai on 22nd instant. It is reported that Chiangchun
Feng told him that peace should be maintained and the
people of Shanghai protected whatever happened.
Provided this was done. Feng did not care whether
the authorities in Shanghai remained loyal to Yuan
Shih Kai or not.
It is reported that the rebels are energetically
recruiting and organising at Ching Ka Jau 金家橋 Tsang
Ka Jau 張家橋 Loh Ka Hung 陸家行 and Huh Ching Tsung 滬慶鎮.
The annual meeting of the Ningpo Guild will be
held at 2 p.m. 23rd instant in the guild offices in
Frenchtown.

Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

编号
上海工部局。
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）
刑事侦缉处
I. O. REG
第 277 号
日期 1916年4月23日

1916年4月23日

先生：

4月22日下午2时，约500名士兵和60名炮兵，配备4门四英寸火炮，以及62匹骑兵用马，由一名名为杨信林（Yang Sing Ling）的军官率领，被派往吴淞。这些士兵来自吴淞。据报，江阴发生骚乱，预计吴淞也将爆发事端，派遣这些部队旨在试图防止事态发生。

4月22日，有大量中国人经铁路涌入上海。抵达者大多来自江阴和吴淞。

一百四十箱军用装备和三十箱弹药于本月22日从兵工厂运往天津附近的莫厂（Mo Tschang）。

数日前，杨将军派遣其一名参谋官员前往南京，鉴于浙江宣布独立，商讨上海当局应采取的政策。该参谋官员于本月22日返回上海。据报，张勋（Chiangchun Feng）告知他，无论发生何种情况，均应维持和平并保护上海民众。只要做到这一点，张勋并不在乎上海当局是否继续效忠袁世凯。

据报，反叛者正在金家桥（Ching Ka Jau）、张家桥（Tsang Ka Jau）、陆家行（Loh Ka Hung）和沪庆镇（Huh Ching Tsung）积极招募人员并进行组织。

宁波同乡会年会将于本月23日下午2时在法租界的同乡会会所举行。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

警务处总监
